headline: Thomas leads the NAC in wins
dek: Thomas has won twelve matches against four losses and one draw across its full schedule, more victories than any other NAC program. That record gives the program a clear edge in a conference where most sides have lost more often than they have won.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring across the NAC is concentrated at the top: Thomas has 51 goals across all matches—more than UMaine-Presque Isle, Lesley, VTSU Lyndon, and VTSU Johnson combined—while conceding 22.

wire.line: Against non-conference opponents, NAC programs have fourteen wins, eleven draws, and 34 losses, scoring 82 goals and conceding 135.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Eleven scheduled matches are past their dates with no published result, among them Thomas against Maine-Fort Kent, Husson at University of New England, and VTSU Lyndon against Alumni.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Husson sophomore forward Miguel Diaz Alvarez has fourteen goals and one assist from 46 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: VTSU Lyndon has conceded 57 goals across all matches, more than any other NAC program, while scoring eleven.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: UMaine-Presque Isle goalkeeper Brett Senal has made 69 saves while allowing 22 goals, a 0.758 save percentage.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: UMaine-Farmington has spread its offense across at least thirteen different goal scorers this season.

last_match.line: The result ended Thomas's unbeaten run across its late-season NAC matches.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
